description_en: Ends a co-streaming session by calling DeleteConference. This operation is typically used to end a session from the management console or to forcibly end a session that has not been exited for an extended period of time
description_zh: 调用DeleteConference结束连麦。一般用于管理后台结束，或长时间未退出时的强制结束
kebab_example: aliyun imp delete-conference --app-id 7m000q --room-id AE35-0000-T95F --user-id as0000hs --conference-id fb0f-0000-4cb1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteConference

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. This ID is generated when you create the application in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The room ID. This ID is returned by the room creation operation
parameters.help_zh: 房间ID，由创建房间接口返回
parameters.name: room_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the operator. The value can contain only letters and digits and is up to 36 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 操作者用户ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36个字符
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the co-streaming resource
parameters.name: conference_id
